name: Apex International Financial Engineering Res. & Tech. Co., Ltd
summary: Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Apex International Financial Engineering Res. & Tech. Co., Ltd delivers specialized financial information services, primarily catering to clients in Taiwan and China. The company provides a comprehensive suite of financial engineering solutions, including tools for managing financial assets, overseeing investment transactions, and mitigating financial risks. Its offerings extend to intelligent investment solutions, such as real-time stock market systems, alongside various technological applications like VR/AR/MR simulation platforms, smart energy conservation systems, and videoconferencing solutions. Apex International is also a key developer of FinTech software and project services for both financial and academic institutions. This includes a variety of Robo-Advisor services, complemented by educational initiatives and platforms like its digital finance school, smart cloud finance platforms, and applications utilizing Blockchain and Big Data analysis. Furthermore, the company supplies advanced derivatives systems to the local financial sector and provides integrated financial trading systems designed to assist securities firms and bill-finance corporations in obtaining new licenses for diverse products such as warrants, IRS, FRA, IPO, swaptions, PGN, and ELN.
